target.database_guard: QA identity is asserted by the operator; this client cannot inspect the selected database name.

scope.auth_session_activity: Synthetic login/logout only; authentication bookkeeping may run.

limits: Direct localhost API measurements do not measure time-to-usable browser content, QR scanning, camera, or network outside loopback.
P95/P90 are descriptive summaries; the SRS does not define a required percentile.
P07 source-event propagation is not measured without a controlled source mutation; this harness performs none.
A numeric comparison with an SRS threshold is not a formal Pass result.

numeric_threshold_comparisons.warning: Descriptive local API comparison only; this is not an SRS pass/fail result.

P04.dataset_note: The target cattle count is checked from dashboard. Requested 24-month range and safe aggregate counts are recorded; date-by-date historical coverage is not proven by this client.

P07.read_only_probe: No read-only endpoint exposes time since a source mutation; measuring propagation requires a controlled source event.
P07.required_manual_follow_up: On a dedicated disposable synthetic record, time source save to event-driven reminder update and separately measure scheduled reconciliation; do not mutate this fixture as part of this harness.

P06.request_pattern: Each authenticated session performs dashboard GET, filtered report POST (read-only service), and cattle detail GET in sequence; 100 sessions begin behind a start gate.
